lead: Nigeria demanded two permanent UN Security Council seats for Africa and signed a deal with the United States to draw American investment into its mineral sector, estimated at $700 billion. Communities in Borgu, Niger State, published the names of 547 worshippers they say were abducted, against the governor's figure of 33. The Super Eagles survived a scare to beat Madagascar 2-1 in Uyo, a Bungudu council chairman escaped after two months in captivity, and Atiku gave N20 million to families of the 37 miners who died in custody.

items.h: Nigeria demands two permanent Security Council seats for Africa
items.s: President Tinubu's address to the UN General Assembly said Africa can no longer remain on the margins of global decision-making.

items.h: Nigeria and US sign minerals investment framework
items.s: Signed in New York, the framework is meant to bring US capital into solid minerals, which the government values at about $700 billion.

items.h: Niger communities list 547 abducted worshippers, disputing governor's 33
items.s: Communities in Borgu released names of people they say were taken in mosque attacks in Dekara District, contradicting Governor Mohammed Bago.

items.h: Super Eagles beat Madagascar 2-1 in Uyo
items.s: Nigeria survived a scare to win their opening 2027 AFCON qualifier.

items.h: Bungudu council chairman escapes after two months in captivity
items.s: Nura Umar Abdullahi and four other kidnap victims escaped and were received by troops in Zamfara.

items.h: Atiku gives N20m to families of miners who died in custody
items.s: Atiku Abubakar gave N20 million to the bereaved families of the mining suspects who died while held by the Civil Defence Corps in Niger State.

items.h: Ardova-led consortium to buy Powergas, Africa's largest CNG producer
items.s: A.P. Moller Capital's infrastructure fund and Impala agreed to sell 100 per cent of the company.

items.h: Gas fund says N671bn public capital drew N1.6trn private investment
items.s: The Midstream and Downstream Gas Infrastructure Fund described the leverage achieved across projects.

items.h: DisCos collected N1.41trn in seven months but missed N45bn in July
items.s: Collection efficiency improved over last year, but uncollected bills remain large.

items.h: Sterling Financial consolidates shares ten-to-one
items.s: The holding company began its approved share capital reconstruction.

items.h: Gombe PDP clears Pantami and two others for fresh primary
items.s: Isa Pantami, Khamisu Mailantarki and Usman Garry will contest after the court voided the earlier vote.

items.h: El-Rufai is deputy chairman of Atiku's campaign council
items.s: ADC chieftain Dele Momodu defended the appointment.

items.h: Moghalu rejects inclusion in Atiku's policy team
items.s: The former CBN deputy governor said he was not consulted.

items.h: Zamfara governor tells Wike to join APC or stay out
items.s: The row over Wike's Rainbow Coalition continued as he tied APC prospects to FCT projects.

items.h: Makinde and Olawepo-Hashim agree on national unity government
items.s: The APM and Accord candidates met, and the APM accused Tinubu of abdicating to a cabal.

items.h: ADC dares APC to produce any judgment convicting Atiku
items.s: The campaign responded to insults from APC spokesman Felix Morka.

items.h: Rivers ADC governorship candidate Ibraye quits
items.s: Tonte Ibraye resigned from the party with a warning about its 2027 prospects.

items.h: Three remanded over murder of Kano social media commentator
items.s: A Shari'a court ordered three men held over the killing of Ibrahim Khalil Dan Shagamu.

items.h: KC Luxury remanded over 184.5kg cocaine
items.s: A Lagos Federal High Court remanded the socialite and two others in NDLEA custody.

items.h: Bauchi police detain 27 over murder and rape
items.s: Arrests came in operations over three weeks.

items.h: Nasarawa police foil kidnap plot
items.s: Four suspects allegedly planned to kill their victim after collecting ransom.

items.h: Plateau assures travellers on Jos-Barkin Ladi road
items.s: The government promised safe passage after an attack.

items.h: Kano tops NECO results as English and maths passes fall
items.s: Kano had the best results in NECO's 2026 internal exam, while the share of candidates with five credits including English and mathematics slipped from 61.60 to 58.67 per cent.

items.h: Suleja protest over plan to turn university land into market
items.s: Residents and students objected to converting land meant for IBB University.

items.h: Scrap dealers to halt supplies to steel firms from 1 October
items.s: The association protested sudden changes in metal trading.

items.h: Ondo launches AI system for payroll and pensions
items.s: Governor Aiyedatiwa unveiled Ondo AI for personnel records.

items.h: Victoria Island power plant targeted for December
items.s: Elektron Energy's 40MW plant was inspected by the Lagos regulator.

items.h: Dangote's $660m pipeline links Ethiopia and Djibouti
items.s: Leaders of both countries praised the Damarjog-Dewele project.

items.h: UAC to sell 43% of DP World Logistics to TGI
items.s: The stake goes to 22 Plus Invest.

items.h: SAN warns against revoking Benin-Asaba concession
items.s: Abiodun Olatunji said the FG must follow the contract.

items.h: NNPC-Seplat JV offers free eye care to 6,000
items.s: The project includes sight restoration surgery.

items.h: Delegates walk out on Netanyahu at UNGA
items.s: Dozens left as he defended Israel's military campaigns.

items.h: Man City reportedly guilty of 114 Premier League charges
items.s: Sanctions loom after the long investigation.
